walkthroughs.body_html:
World History Topics (two, same as SL) — a core area of History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

World History Topics (two, same as SL) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with World History Topics (two, same as SL).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

options: Locarno
Munich
Yalta
Geneva

mcqs.q: Who signed the 1939 non-aggression pact for the USSR?

Litvinov
Khrushchev
Beria

mcqs.q: Why did Stalin reject the Marshall Plan?
options: Stalin rejected the Marshall Plan because the USSR did not need money after WWII.
Nixon resigned because he lost the 1972 election to Carter.
Stalin rejected the Marshall Plan because it required countries to fight Germany again.
He saw it as dollar imperialism that would pull Eastern Europe into the US orbit; he set up Comecon as an Eastern bloc alternative and blocked satellite states from joining.
